description: Complete a UCP checkout session: pass checkout_id. Payment processing is not configured yet, so an open session answers 501 until a payment provider is set up; a session that is already completed is returned as it is. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

checkout_id.description: The checkout session: its id, as create_ucp_checkout and list_ucp_checkouts show it.

name: complete_ucp_checkout
